_provenance: Real sample run. Reply text and per-dimension scores were produced by Claude Opus during the build session (same model family LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic calls); retrieval, composite math, and aggregation are computed by the project code. Regenerate with `python run_all.py` + a real LLM_PROVIDER. See sample_run/build_sample_artifacts.py.
interpretation: Lower is more stable. A mean stdev near 0 on the 0-5 composite scale means repeated scoring of the same reply lands on ~the same number; a mean stdev above ~0.5 would mean the composite isn't precise enough to trust small differences between responses.
